name: New Random
summary: This EA opens random buy or sell trades at each new bar, essentially gambling on market direction without any technical analysis or strategy logic. It uses fixed lot sizing and places both stop loss and take profit levels on each trade, then waits for the next bar to repeat the process.
summary_zh: 这个EA在每个新K线时随机开多或空单，本质上是无策略逻辑的赌博式交易。它使用固定手数，每笔交易都设置止损和止盈，然后在下一根K线重复此过程。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的策略概念完全基于随机数生成器决定交易方向，没有任何技术指标或市场分析作为入场依据。入场条件是每当新K线形成时，使用MathRand()生成随机数，若为偶数则买入，若为奇数则卖出。出场条件依赖预设的止损和止盈水平，没有追踪止损或动态出场机制。仓位管理采用固定手数，不会根据账户余额或波动率调整仓位大小。资金管理方面完全没有风险控制逻辑，不会检查账户保证金比例、最大持仓数量或累计亏损限制。整体而言，这是一个概念验证或演示性质的EA，不具备实战价值。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept of this EA is entirely based on a random number generator to decide trade direction, with no technical indicators or market analysis as entry basis. Entry conditions are triggered on each new bar formation, using MathRand() to generate a random number — if even, it opens a buy; if odd, it opens a sell. Exit conditions rely solely on preset stop loss and take profit levels, with no trailing stop or dynamic exit mechanism. Position sizing uses fixed lots with no adjustment based on account balance or market volatility. Money management lacks any risk control logic — there is no check on account margin ratio, maximum open positions, or cumulative loss limits. Overall, this is a proof-of-concept or demo EA with no practical trading value.

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description: EA魔术编号用于识别订单
parameters.description_en: EA魔术编号用于识别订单

pros: 代码结构简单清晰，适合初学者学习EA基本框架
每笔交易都设置了止损和止盈，有基本的风险退出机制
使用魔术编号区分订单，避免与其他EA冲突
新K线判断逻辑避免了同一根K线重复开仓
pros_en: Simple and clear code structure, suitable for beginners learning basic EA framework
Each trade has stop loss and take profit set, providing basic risk exit mechanism
Uses magic number to distinguish orders, avoiding conflicts with other EAs
New bar detection logic prevents duplicate entries on the same bar
cons: 入场逻辑完全随机，没有任何市场分析或技术指标支撑
没有仓位管理，不会根据账户资金或波动率调整手数
缺少最大持仓数量限制，可能在短时间内大量开仓
没有考虑点差和滑点对交易成本的影响
缺少资金回撤控制和最大亏损限制
cons_en: Entry logic is completely random with no market analysis or technical indicator support
No position management — lot size is not adjusted based on account equity or volatility
Lacks maximum position count limit, potentially opening many positions in a short time
Does not consider spread and slippage impact on trading costs
Lacks drawdown control and maximum loss limits
improvements: 增加技术指标过滤条件，避免在不利市场条件下随机开仓
添加最大持仓数量和最大回撤限制来控制整体风险
实现动态仓位管理，根据账户余额和ATR调整手数大小
improvements_en: Add technical indicator filters to avoid random entries in unfavorable market conditions
Add maximum position count and maximum drawdown limits to control overall risk
Implement dynamic position sizing based on account balance and ATR

risk_points: 完全随机入场，交易结果等同于赌博，长期必然亏损
没有最大持仓限制，可能在新K线密集出现时大量开仓导致爆仓
没有考虑点差成本，在高点差品种上止盈可能无法覆盖交易成本
risk_points_en: Completely random entry means trading results are equivalent to gambling, guaranteed to lose long-term
No maximum position limit could lead to account blowup when many bars form in quick succession
Spread cost not considered — take profit may not cover trading costs on high-spread instruments
